source_refs.note: Exercise 5.1 (book p. 154), Question 8; answer key PDF 306 (Answers 5.1, key numbered 10).

blocks.prompt: 8 (i) Find the equation of family of lines through the point of intersection of the lines \(x + 2y - 3 = 0\), \(3x - y + 4 = 0\). Find the member of the family which is parallel to a line with slope \(\frac{3}{2}\).
blocks.explanation:
Do lines ke intersection point se guzarne wali saari lines ki family \(\ell_1 + k\ell_2 = 0\) hai.
Humein us family ka woh member chahiye jo ek aur shart poori kare: slope \(\frac{3}{2}\) wali line ke parallel ho.
Intersection point nikalne ki zaroorat nahi; family khud us point ka khayal rakhti hai.
Plan: family, us ki slope \(k\) mein, slope ki shart se \(k\), phir wapas family mein.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(x + 2y - 3 = 0\) aur \(3x - y + 4 = 0\).
Maloom karna: in ke intersection point se family, aur us ka woh member jo slope \(\frac{3}{2}\) wali line ke parallel ho.
Tareeqa: \(\ell_1 + k\ell_2 = 0\) (Section 5.5, Example 11), phir slope ki shart.
Dhyan rahe ke yeh sawal Example 11 ka jurwan bhai hai; wahan bhi family, slope aur shart wala yahi tareeqa tha.

Family
\[x + 2y - 3 + k(3x - y + 4) = 0\]
\[(1 + 3k)x + (2 - k)y + (4k - 3) = 0\]
Kyun: \(\ell_1 + k\ell_2 = 0\) ki har line meeting point se guzarti hai; \(x\), \(y\) aur constant terms ikatthe kiye. (Answer key \(k\) ki jagah \(\lambda\) likhti hai, farq sirf naam ka hai.)
Yahan \(k\) ek 'dial' ki tarah hai: dial ghumao to line ghoomti hai, lekin hamesha usi meeting point ke gird. Humein bas woh position dhoondni hai jahan line ki slope \(\frac{3}{2}\) ho.

Family ki slope
\[m = -\dfrac{1 + 3k}{2 - k}\]
Kyun: \(ax + by + c = 0\) ki slope \(-\frac{a}{b}\) hoti hai; yahan \(a\) aur \(b\) dono \(k\) par depend karte hain.
Slope ki is formula mein k do jagah aata hai, upar bhi aur neeche bhi; is liye shart lagane ke baad cross-multiply karna parta hai.

Shart lagayein
\[-\dfrac{1 + 3k}{2 - k} = \dfrac{3}{2}\]
\[-2 - 6k = 6 - 3k\]
\[-3k = 8\]
\[k = -\dfrac{8}{3}\]
Kyun: parallel lines ki slopes barabar hoti hain; cross-multiply kar ke \(k\) ki simple equation ban gayi.

\(k = -\frac{8}{3}\) ko family mein rakhein
\[\left(1 - 8\right)x + \left(2 + \tfrac{8}{3}\right)y + \left(-\tfrac{32}{3} - 3\right) = 0\]
\[-7x + \tfrac{14}{3}y - \tfrac{41}{3} = 0\]
\[-21x + 14y - 41 = 0\]
\[21x - 14y + 41 = 0\]
Kyun: har coefficient mein \(k\) ki value rakhi, phir fractions khatam karne ke liye multiply kiya aur saada shakal banai.
Dhyan dein: aakhir mein poori equation ko \(-1\) se multiply kar ke \(x\) ka coefficient positive kiya; is se line nahi badalti, sirf likhne ka andaz saaf ho jata hai.

Tasdeeq:
Slope \(\frac{21}{14} = \frac{3}{2}\), sahi. Di hui lines \(\left(-\frac{5}{7}, \frac{13}{7}\right)\) par milti hain, aur \(21\left(-\frac{5}{7}\right) - 14\left(\frac{13}{7}\right) + 41 = -15 - 26 + 41 = 0\). Answer key 10(i) se milta hai.
Agar aap pehle intersection point nikal kar point-slope form lagate to bhi yahi jawab aata; family wala tareeqa sirf chhota rasta hai.

blocks.prompt: 8 (ii) Find the equation of family of lines through the point of intersection of the lines \(x + 2y - 3 = 0\), \(3x - y + 4 = 0\). Find the member of the family which is perpendicular to the line \(3x + 4y = 0\).
blocks.explanation:
Do lines ke intersection point se guzarne wali saari lines ki family \(\ell_1 + k\ell_2 = 0\) hai.
Humein us family ka woh member chahiye jo ek aur shart poori kare: \(3x + 4y = 0\) par perpendicular ho (us ki slope \(-\frac{3}{4}\), is liye humein slope \(\frac{4}{3}\) chahiye).
Intersection point nikalne ki zaroorat nahi; family khud us point ka khayal rakhti hai.
Plan: family, us ki slope \(k\) mein, slope ki shart se \(k\), phir wapas family mein.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(x + 2y - 3 = 0\) aur \(3x - y + 4 = 0\).
Maloom karna: in ke intersection point se family, aur us ka woh member jo \(3x + 4y = 0\) par perpendicular ho (us ki slope \(-\frac{3}{4}\), is liye humein slope \(\frac{4}{3}\) chahiye).
Tareeqa: \(\ell_1 + k\ell_2 = 0\) (Section 5.5, Example 11), phir slope ki shart.
Yahan shart perpendicular hone ki hai, is liye slopes ka product minus ek rakhenge.

Family
\[x + 2y - 3 + k(3x - y + 4) = 0\]
\[(1 + 3k)x + (2 - k)y + (4k - 3) = 0\]
Kyun: \(\ell_1 + k\ell_2 = 0\) ki har line meeting point se guzarti hai; \(x\), \(y\) aur constant terms ikatthe kiye. (Answer key \(k\) ki jagah \(\lambda\) likhti hai, farq sirf naam ka hai.)
Family wohi hai jo part (i) mein thi; sirf shart badli hai. Is liye family aur us ki slope dobara likh kar seedha nayi shart lagayenge.

Family ki slope
\[m = -\dfrac{1 + 3k}{2 - k}\]
Kyun: \(ax + by + c = 0\) ki slope \(-\frac{a}{b}\) hoti hai; yahan \(a\) aur \(b\) dono \(k\) par depend karte hain.

Shart lagayein
\[-\dfrac{1 + 3k}{2 - k} \times \left(-\dfrac{3}{4}\right) = -1\]
\[-\dfrac{1 + 3k}{2 - k} = \dfrac{4}{3}\]
\[-3 - 9k = 8 - 4k\]
\[k = -\dfrac{11}{5}\]
Kyun: perpendicular lines ke liye \(m_1m_2 = -1\); cross-multiply kar ke \(k\) ki simple equation ban gayi.
Dhyan dein: \(3x + 4y = 0\) ki slope \(-\frac{3}{4}\) hai, \(\frac{3}{4}\) nahi. Perpendicular slope \(\frac{4}{3}\) hai: ulta karo aur sign badlo.

\(k = -\frac{11}{5}\) ko family mein rakhein
\[\left(1 - \tfrac{33}{5}\right)x + \left(2 + \tfrac{11}{5}\right)y + \left(-\tfrac{44}{5} - 3\right) = 0\]
\[-\tfrac{28}{5}x + \tfrac{21}{5}y - \tfrac{59}{5} = 0\]
\[28x - 21y + 59 = 0\]
Kyun: har coefficient mein \(k\) ki value rakhi, phir fractions khatam karne ke liye multiply kiya aur saada shakal banai.
Pehle 5 se multiply kiya taake fractions khatam hon, phir poori equation ko minus ek se multiply kar ke x ka coefficient positive kiya.

Tasdeeq:
Slope \(\frac{28}{21} = \frac{4}{3}\) aur \(\frac{4}{3} \times \left(-\frac{3}{4}\right) = -1\). \(\left(-\frac{5}{7}, \frac{13}{7}\right)\) par: \(28\left(-\frac{5}{7}\right) - 21\left(\frac{13}{7}\right) + 59 = -20 - 39 + 59 = 0\). Answer key 10(ii) se milta hai.
Dono parts ka jawab answer key (number 10) se milta hai; key ne k ki jagah lambda likha hai.
